extended_definition: Bucket-level IAM allows IAM permissions to be applied directly to individual Cloud Storage buckets.

supporting_pages.title: Identity and Access Management \_|\_ Cloud Storage \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: If you view the IAM policy for an individual bucket using the Google Cloud console , you do see project-level permissions that apply to that bucket; however, other Cloud Storage tools, such as gcloud storage and the Client Libraries only return the policy of the bucket and don't include information inherited from the project-level policy.
Convenience values Cloud Storage supports convenience values , which are a special set of principals that can be applied specifically to your IAM bucket policies.
The IAM roles that allow you to control IAM deny policies can only be applied at the organization level.
